subject: physics
title: Gravitational Potential and Escape Velocity
welcome_lead: Climb out of a gravity well with V = -GM/r and earn escape velocity v_esc.
meta_desc: A-Level Gravitational Fields adventure on potential, potential energy and escape velocity.
final_note: Reach v_esc at the surface and you'll never come back — kinetically.

walkthroughs.body_html: V(r) = -GM/r, set to zero at infinity. Closer to the mass, deeper (more negative) the well. Work done from infinity to r equals m V.
The PE of mass m near mass M. Difference matters: ΔU = U₂ − U₁ is the work needed to move m between two points.
Set ½ m v² = GMm/R. Solve: v_esc = √(2GM/R). For Earth, about 11.2 km/s. Independent of the escaping object's mass.
